method: No audit output is trusted as evidence: only its channel NAMES seed the sample.
The LIVE tdtchannels.com catalogue is loaded and every channel is opened by URL.
Playback is judged from decoded frames plus advancing media time in a real browser.
Route stubs are disabled; only the catalogue bytes are seeded same-origin (no CORS upstream).
